project.title: atmospheric bacterial and fungal communities
project.description: Biomass burning in North China Plain has been urgent issues in recent years due to the severe environmental impaction. Bacteria and fungi are ubiquitous in particulate matter, and their taxonomic composition, concentration, ecophysiological function have potentially important implications in atmospheric biochemical cycle and human health. Here we examine bacteria and fungi community composition, abundance and potential function in Yucheng, the center of the North China Plain during summer harvest season in 2014.
